notes: LG U+ completed its new hyperscale IDC 'Pyeongchon 2 Center' in Gwanak-dong, Dongan-gu, Anyang-si in October 2023: nine above-ground and three underground floors, about 44,500 sqm, sized to hold over 200,000 servers. LG U+'s official IDC page lists the Anyang center (Pyeongchon cluster, which also hosts the earlier Pyeongchon 1 IDC). No public MW figure found.
